title: Tronian Pitron V2 510 Draw Activated Battery
description:
Using the Tronian Pitron battery could not be easier. It has no buttons and uses your draw to power the device. The Pitron V2 is a great choice for on-the-go concentrate vaporization. All that is needed is to insert a cartridge, power the unit, and start inhaling.

The Tronian Pitron has a USB-C charge port built into the bottom of the battery. A big time upgrade to the previous version which had a Micro USB. The Pitron V2 Battery is easier and faster to charge.

Superior Calibration
The Tronian Pitron has been thoroughly tested with a multitude of different viscosity concentrates.

Key Features:
Manufacturer Tronian
Battery 320 mAh
Control Draw Activated
Heat time Instant
Heating Style Conduction
Max Cartridge Diameter 11mm
Temperature 3.5V
Compatibility 510 Threaded Concentrates
Warranty 1 Year Limited Warranty

Included:
Tronian Pitron V2

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste.
If you need one — we’ve got options.

Please research the product you are interested in before purchasing. Tronian products are final sales and warranty is through the manufacturer.

If you have issues with your product, send an email to info@tronian.com and a customer service representative will contact you as early as possible to resolve the issue and find the best solution.
